name: June
source:
She is an underground arms dealer who took over from her father, Bo.
She is a multi-lingual, talented woman who usually travels around the world to purchase goods.
When she is in Hong Kong, she pretends to be the owner of a members-only bar, but she keeps a shotgun on the counter so that she is ready at any moment to be lambasted for being a female owner.
As fellow gun enthusiasts, she often engages in gun discussions with Luk, Yuchi, and Yvet.
She is a lesbian, but does not have a partner.
She participated in Lao Pao's Fortress Manshion raid and cooperated with Yvet.
